items.summary: Improper authentication in Progress WS_FTP Server versions prior to 2024.0.6 and 2025.0.3 on Windows could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to access sensitive information, including administrative credentials. Upgrade to a fixed WS_FTP Server release.

An OS command injection vulnerability in Progress WS_FTP Server versions prior to 2024.0.7 and 2025.0.4 on Windows could allow arbitrary command execution under certain configurations. Upgrade to WS_FTP Server 2024.0.7 or 2025.0.4.

A use-after-free in the Linux kernel's IPv4 TCP handshake code could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to trigger memory corruption; the kernel CNA rates it 9.8. An upstream fix exists, but as of October 29 Ubuntu and RHEL had not yet shipped fixed kernels, so track distro advisories and patch when available.

A path traversal vulnerability in Progress WS_FTP Server versions prior to 2024.0.7 and 2025.0.4 on Windows could allow a delegated Host Administrator to access or modify files outside their authorized scope. Upgrade to WS_FTP Server 2024.0.7 or 2025.0.4.

Missing authorization in the administrative interface of Progress WS_FTP Server versions prior to 2024.0.7 and 2025.0.4 on Windows could allow a delegated Host Administrator to exceed their authorized scope, potentially enabling arbitrary command execution and complete compromise of the server. Upgrade to WS_FTP Server 2024.0.7 or 2025.0.4.
